(2) The forty-nine gates as the model of the seven-by-seven structure (12155-12158, 12329-12338) is Black's own proposal, hedged ('I have proposed'); Nahmanides as a source is left open by Black (12071). (3) Black on the higher intellect: Pico's sympathies 'seem' to lie with the view that it is a mind nearer to man, not God (10430). ATTRIBUTION: where Black translates Pico (Oration, Commento, Heptaplus proems) the claim is scholar_report, because the packet gate refuses primary_text from a scholarly work; the Pico edition (Garin) is not in the registry as a work here.
